journeyText: Open a reachable egg with your pickaxe.
See what hatches and get ready to carry it home.
Plan the return before you take the risk.
Place your animal and start earning cash.
about: Break and Steal an Egg is a Roblox simulation tycoon by ILGames x Eggs. Break eggs to hatch animals, carry them past guards, and place them at your base to earn cash.
Speed, pickaxe progression, and the animal Index give every run a new purpose. Choose a reachable target, finish the delivery, and reinvest in the part of your route that needs help.
faq: Finish one complete run: break an egg, take the animal, escape the guards, and place it at your base.
No active redeem code has been verified in the collected sources. The official listing mentions like-and-group rewards, which are separate from text codes.
Should I upgrade speed or my pickaxe?
Compare one complete run. Inspect pickaxe upgrades when opening eggs is slow, or movement progression when the return is the difficult part. This is practical advice, not a fixed optimal order.
Is this the official game website?
No. This is an independent fan resource. The play button opens the experience by ILGames x Eggs on Roblox.
No. The displayed counts are a historical official-page snapshot collected on October 17, 2026.

articles.title: Beginner Guide
articles.summary: Your first egg-to-base run, one clear step at a time.
sections: Find your base first
Before breaking anything, identify your base and a clear return landmark. Keep the first target nearby so you can learn the entire loop without a long journey.
Break, collect, return
Use the current game prompts to break an egg with your pickaxe. Once the animal appears, pick it up and return past the guards. A hatch alone is not the finished run.
Place before upgrading
Place the animal at your base and check the cash display. Repeat a route you can complete before testing a harder target. Compare upgrades against the step that delayed you most.
Noob to pro without Robux

Begin with the core loop instead of copying the pace of videos that include purchases. Keep your target and route consistent when trying an upgrade; successful deliveries are a useful progress measure.

articles.title: Codes & Free Rewards
articles.summary: What is verified, what is not, and where to check.
sections: Current code status
No active text redeem code has been verified in the collected official sources as of October 17, 2026. This is a verification status, not proof that the game can never introduce codes.
Free group rewards

The official game description asks players to like the game and join the developer group for free rewards. It does not specify a reward or publish a redeem string. Check the live reward prompts after joining ILGames x Eggs.
Before trying a new code

Match the game creator and place ID 114326934417838. Look for an exact code in a developer announcement, then check whether the current game offers a redemption control. Never enter your Roblox password on a code website.

articles.title: Pickaxe Upgrades
articles.summary: Choose a tool upgrade for the problem in your next run.
sections: What your pickaxe does
The pickaxe breaks eggs. The official description also names pickaxe upgrades as part of progression. A harder target is useful only when you can finish opening it and deliver the animal.
When an upgrade helps

Time the opening part of a familiar run, then compare it with the return. If breaking takes most of the attempt, inspect the next pickaxe offer and its current cost. If delivery fails, fix that before assuming a tool purchase solves it.
Prices and the rarest pickaxe

Video titles mention rare pickaxes, but the collected sources do not establish a complete, current shop table. Read the live price and power display; this guide does not invent a best-in-slot name or price.

articles.title: Speed Guide
articles.summary: Make the trip home part of your progression plan.
sections: Movement has a job

The developer names speed progression and escaping guards in the core loop. Use movement improvements to support a delivery you understand, rather than judging an upgrade only by its displayed number.
Compare the same route
Choose a familiar egg and return landmark. Compare the full round trip before and after a change, including whether you actually place the animal. A shorter failed attempt is not improved income.
Trails and current prices

The research includes trail-price searches and gameplay footage. It does not provide an independently verified current price list. Follow the current movement, equipment, and training prompts rather than relying on an older shop layout.

articles.title: Eggs & Hatching
articles.summary: Choose a target you can open, carry, and bring home.
sections: From egg to animal
The official description says to break eggs to hatch rare animals. After opening, the important next steps are taking the animal, escaping the guards, and placing it at your base.
What makes an egg useful?

For a cash run, compare the complete delivery effort and the animal’s displayed income. For a collection run, choose a missing Index target. These are different goals, so there is no verified universal best egg here.
Titanic and giant eggs

Collected player video titles mention Titanic and giant eggs. Those titles do not establish spawn chances, permanent availability, or guaranteed rewards. Confirm the current in-game name and requirements before committing to a long attempt.
Other egg searches
Angelic eggs and Scorpion Titan appear in collected search or video material. Their current mechanics are not verified here; no odds, zone gates, or spawn schedule are asserted.

articles.title: Guards & Escape
articles.summary: Turn a good hatch into a completed delivery.
sections: Plan the return

Identify your base before picking up an animal. For a first attempt, choose a target with a route you can recognize rather than chasing the most distant visible egg. This is planning advice, not a guaranteed safe path.
Commit to the delivery
Once you have the animal, prioritize returning instead of opening menus or investigating another target. The official loop requires escaping the guards and placing the animal at your base.
Learn from a failed attempt

Separate opening, pickup, navigation, and movement. Change one part of the attempt so you can tell what helped. Guard detection distances, patrol schedules, and immunity rules are not documented in the collected official description.

articles.title: Money & Base Income
articles.summary: Make successful animal deliveries work for your base.
sections: Income begins with placement
The developer confirms that animals placed at your base earn cash. After a delivery, check that placement is complete and inspect the base display before counting the run as productive.
A practical cash routine

Repeat a manageable route and compare the time needed to finish it. A valuable hatch that never reaches the base does not complete the income loop. Prioritize consistent placement before extending your route.
Choose the next expense

Describe the bottleneck: opening eggs, returning, or choosing a collection target. Inspect the relevant current upgrade before spending. No fixed income-per-second table or guaranteed get-rich timing has been verified.

articles.title: Animals & Index
articles.summary: Give every animal a purpose: income or collection.
sections: Use the live Index
The official game description sets collecting animals in the Index as a goal. Look for a missing entry and use it to make the next run specific, then inspect your collection after delivery.
Best versus rarest pets

A base-income decision and a rarity goal are not the same thing. Compare the animal’s live display with your purpose. The collected official sources do not provide a complete pet tier list or rarity probabilities.
Merging and special animals

Collected gameplay research mentions merging, while video titles mention Omega. Check the current machine, inputs, and result preview in the game. Do not assume a recipe, weight formula, or guaranteed output from a title.
Fish income and models

A complete fish Index, fish income table, and downloadable pet model library have not been verified. Use the live Index for actual names and values; this page does not present missing data as an authoritative list.

articles.title: All Guides
articles.summary: Find the next useful answer for your egg run.
sections: Choose the failed step
Start with the beginner guide if the loop is new. Use pickaxes for slow opening, speed and escape for difficult returns, and the base guide for income planning.
Gamepasses and secrets

The collected video titles include paid runs and secret finds. They do not prove that a purchase is required or that an undocumented route always works. Read the live Roblox offer before buying and keep free progression separate from purchased shortcuts.

articles.title: Community & Developer
articles.summary: The right game, the right creator, and clear source labels.
sections: Official identity
The experience is by ILGames x Eggs, with Roblox place ID 114326934417838. Use the linked developer community for the group mentioned in the official description.
Discord and other social searches

Several servers claim official status. A developer-linked Discord has not been independently confirmed for this site, so no server is labelled Official. A dedicated official Pinterest account is also unverified.
People and accounts

The collected keyword bigspace07 does not establish a verified developer identity. Account-purchase searches do not prove that a marketplace is endorsed; this site provides no account trading or payment service.

articles.title: Privacy Policy
articles.summary: A simple guide to what this static website uses.
sections: Browser preferences
Theme preferences are stored locally in your browser. Search runs in the browser using a downloaded index; this site has no account, payment form, or analytics integration.
External services

Opening Roblox or YouTube takes you to their services. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which receives a font request from your browser. A YouTube player is requested only after you click the video button. Hosting providers may process standard request information according to their own policies.
Advertising

This website displays Adsterra advertising, including banners, native ads and a Social Bar. Advertising providers and their partners may receive your IP address, browser/device information and page request details, and may use cookies or similar technologies to deliver and measure ads. These services load automatically on published pages. Ad content and availability are controlled by the advertising provider.

articles.title: Terms of Use
articles.summary: An independent guide with dated sources.
sections: Fan resource

This site is not affiliated with Roblox Corporation or ILGames x Eggs. Game names, artwork, and videos belong to their respective owners. Links to Roblox open the actual experience; this site does not host the Roblox game.
Changing information
Game balance, offers, and availability can change. Dated guides and practical suggestions are provided for reference; current in-game prompts take precedence for transactions and progression choices.
